ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels, estimated at approximately 90:10 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field across both lobes; black pigmentation localized to a thin continuous band along the trailing edge and fluke tips; singular high-contrast black circular spot in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe; faint pinkish-grey mottling on the lower proximal margin of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 100 degrees and a high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude 3-8 pixels) distributed continuously along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into a sharp upward taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single well-defined circular dark pixel cluster on the right lobe; smaller dark clusters at the extreme distal tips consistent with barnacle-related scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two small circular indentations/perforations visible near the edge of the right lobe tip; highly irregular and ragged trailing edge topography indicating mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular spot isolated within the white field of the right lobe surface.
